title: Gideon and the Hymn
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Astrid Brightwater, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
